ui_bugs.issue: Click on achievements-toggle did not expand grid in our run (6 badges before AND after click). Likely caused by the 'Continue current session?' Radix dialog overlay re-mounting and intercepting pointer events on Dashboard. Toggle button itself is wired correctly (setExpanded toggle); when the dialog is closed the toggle works in dev. RECOMMEND: dismiss/close the continue-dialog on Dashboard mount path before allowing click-throughs, OR raise the panel z-index above the Radix overlay (or simply ensure tests close the dialog first via continue-yes/continue-discard buttons rather than Escape).

After typing 250 into trip-miles-input and waiting 2.2s for the auto-save debounce, finish-btn remained disabled and finish-miles-warning remained visible in our automated run. This may be the same overlay-intercept issue (continue-dialog open during input), OR the Dashboard's finish-btn disabled flag may be reading from server-state (session.total_trip_miles) but not from local TripSheetForm pending state until next /api/trip-sessions/active refetch. RECOMMEND: verify the disabled prop reads from the live form state debounced into session, and ensure dashboard refreshes session after the PUT completes (or expose a local 'milesEntered' boolean from TripSheetForm via callback).

DriverProfile model: ge=0/le=80 on years_experience and ge=0/le=20_000_000 on lifetime_miles produce clean 422 with helpful Pydantic messages.

Splash screen overlays the page on first load — automated tests must set sessionStorage.tm_splash_seen='1' before navigating, otherwise role buttons receive no clicks. Documented in context_for_next_testing_agent.

AchievementsPanel default visible = last-3-earned + first-3-locked = 6 cards. Spec says toggle reveals all 20; component logic supports it but a Radix dialog mounted on top of dashboard appears to intercept the click in real usage. Worth confirming with user-flow testing where the continue-dialog was already dismissed.

rca of the issue: Achievements toggle + finish-btn behaviors most likely root-caused by the Radix continue-dialog (Session in Progress) re-asserting itself on Dashboard mount and intercepting pointer events on the elements behind it. Pressing Escape dismisses visually but the dialog re-mounts on subsequent re-render cycles. Recommended mitigation: add data-testids to the dialog's Yes/No buttons and explicitly close in tests; or in production, ensure Dashboard does not re-mount the dialog after first dismissal.
